events.title: Exam Announcement
events.description: Ms. Sunday announces that a written test will take place on Day 6 and asks the class to prepare using the material discussed during the week.
events.evaluation_role: Primary MRA and BCR anchor for exam awareness and preparation behavior.

events.title: Classroom Rules Change
events.description: Ms. Sunday announces that students must raise a hand and wait to be acknowledged before speaking during class discussion.
events.evaluation_role: Primary MRA and BCR anchor for rule awareness and classroom conduct.

events.title: Group Discussion
events.description: Ms. Sunday assigns the students a group discussion and asks each student to contribute to a shared explanation of the current lesson.
events.evaluation_role: Primary MRA and BCR anchor for group coordination and participation behavior.

events.title: Class Leader Election
events.description: Ms. Sunday asks the class to nominate and discuss a student who could take responsibility as class leader.
events.evaluation_role: Primary MRA and BCR anchor for initiative, peer trust, and responsibility behavior.

events.title: Daily Quiz
events.description: Ms. Sunday begins the announced written test and asks each student to respond based on their preparation and understanding.
events.evaluation_role: Primary MRA and BCR anchor for prior announcement recall and study preparation.
